rv.q: This emotioinally affecting and wonderfully performed production of “On Your Feet! The Story of Emilio & Gloria Estefan” will have you doing just that.

Make no mistake - this show is muy caliente on all fronts and audiences will be leaving the theatre with smiles on their faces and a Latin -inspired spring in their step as this musical is very appropriately titled.
On Your Feet is a party from the start.
But I didn't hesitate to dance out of the theater with the rest of the crowd.
On Your Feet! The Story of Emilio & Gloria Estefan is far from groundbreaking theater, but it is certainly uplifting.
Nonetheless, for all its shortcomings, there is no denying the raw energy, beautiful music (especially the harmonies) and lively dancing that are On Your Feet! ’s strengths.
